summary: Iteration 20 tested Photo Wall Moderation, Verified Organiser Filter, and Payout Reminder Preview (backend + frontend). Wrote /app/backend/tests/test_iteration20_photo_mod_verified_payout.py — 20/20 pytest cases pass. Frontend Playwright confirmed: Admin → Photo wall tab (admin-tab-photos, photo-moderation-panel, photomod-filter-reported|hidden|all with counts, photomod-empty), Events page events-verified-only toggle + event-verified-<id> badges (12 verified in demo — filter effect proven at API level by temporarily unverifying partner2), Console Payouts reminder-preview with reminder-subject/reminder-intro rendering the 'nothing to send' state (will_send=false for ops.manager in baseline), regression payouts table + photo-wall on finished event 6a7b73e34a13de566dbd110f, and mobile 390px admin photo grid. Demo data restored (partner2 verified=true; no leftover payouts/reminders/photos/reports). Idempotency of photo report, own-photo 400, admin hide+warn -> users.warnings++ + audit + email + reports resolved, unknown action -> 400, non-admin -> 403 all verified.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 4194 lines — the new photo-moderation + payout-preview blocks would benefit from being split into their own routers (routes/moderation.py, routes/payouts.py). The 700-line guideline is exceeded ~6x and E1 keeps stacking features into the same file.
admin_photos initialises `flt = {"reported": {"$exists": False}}` before immediately reassigning it — dead code, harmless but confusing.

moderate_photo restore branch resets report_count/reported_by but does NOT clear last_report_reason/last_reported_at, so a restored photo still carries stale report metadata visible to admins on the 'all' tab.

payout_digest.items uses `net` as float and the frontend does `i.net.toLocaleString()` — if a payout ever comes back as int/null it would crash reminder-line rendering. Frontend already does `Number(preview.total)` but not per-line — worth normalising in the backend.
next_monday() sets hh:mm:ss=03:30:00 but does not zero-out sub-second precision explicitly — fine for isoformat but worth a note; verified in tests (weekday=0, hour=3, minute=30).
GET /api/console/payout-reminder returns manager_id and email of the caller; low-sensitivity but the frontend never uses manager_id — consider trimming.
PhotoWall.pick() still calls load() only at the end; on multi-file upload failures partial success isn't shown until the loop finishes. (Carried over from iter19 review.)
